A separate personal note is the right choice. The fetched description describes the page; my note records why I saved it or what I thought about it. The note should be editable, support Markdown-style formatting, and display that formatting when I view the bookmark.

I would not make the operators depend on capitalization. `AND`, `and`, and `And` should behave the same, since the rest of search ignores capitalization. Quoting the word—such as `"or"` or `"OR"`—should be the one clear way to search for it literally.

With that adjustment, the search, tag reuse, combined filters, and separate note match what I pictured.
